sentences.text: This first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C has been filed on behalf of applicant for grant of bail, pending trial.
The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.148/2012 o f Police Station Baikunthpur, District Rewa for commission of offence punishable under Section 363, 366, 376 of IPC.
He is in detention since 05.12.2022.

As per prosecution story, on 04.09.2012 prosecutrix's father lodged an FIR that his 15 years old daughter had gone for studies at High School, but his son while going to Rewa had seen his daughter sitting with Govind Kol and Manoj Kori.
Son thought that they all are going to school but when her daughter did not come back they searched for her but she could not be traced.

Her daughter has eloped with someone and has taken Rs.3000/- cash, one gold chain, one gold ring finger, one gold Buddh Sen vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110988881/
1 ear ring, Mangalsutr, Payal etc. with her.

sentences.text: FIR was registered.
After investigation, charge sheet was filed.
Prosecutrix returned and appeared before the Police on 13.09.2012 and alleged commission of rape by Budhsen with her.
Charge sheet was filed in his absence.
He could be arrested almost after 10 years of incident.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
Prosecutrix has been examined before the trial on 30.01.2023.

In her evidence before the trial Court,
she has denied commission of rape by the applicant.

Therefore, having taken into consideration the fact that prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution story and detention period of the applicant, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

I t is directed that applicant - Buddh Sen be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
